summary:
For journey favorite frog
Why do not you burn the nosy little bit?
Left-type simulation app "Journey frog"
description:
A traveling frog sends a traveling frog out on a journey.
This is an app that allows you to relax and wait for your return.

When you give a frog something to eat from your trip,
Let us know about your trip with photos
Rare "souvenirs" from various places that I picked up during my travels
They will give you a present (sometimes you may not receive one)

◆How to play
1. Harvest clover
2. Let's shop for sticky goods at Omise
3. Complete your trip!

Once the task is completed, the frog will depart on its own.
Now, let's wait for you to come back safely.

A free and carefree journey with the frog
Please take your time and enjoy.

[Supported devices]
AndroidOS6.0 or later
